name: ado-pr-review
description: Review the Azure DevOps pull requests assigned to you: triage, deep review with build and tests, inline threads, vote, and re-check while waiting for the author

loop_minutes.title: Re-check interval (minutes)
loop_minutes.description: How long to wait between re-checks while PRs are waiting for their author (1-60). Override per run with --every <minutes>.
